subject: geom_tile fill aesthetic crash depending on data value

messages.author: c2734659a66b07e8
messages.subject: geom_tile fill aesthetic crash depending on data value
parts:
HI

Could you let me know the correct procedure for reporting bugs and/or any insights on the following:

ggplot 0.9.3.1 under R 3.0.2 (and 3.0.1)

The following code works fine:

b <- data.frame(x=rep(100L,10), y=as.factor(1L:10L), f=rep(100,10))
ggplot(b) +
  geom_tile(aes(y=y, x=x, fill=f))

but, simply changing the values of f to 125 as follows causes an application failure:

b <- data.frame(x=rep(100L,10), y=as.factor(1L:10L), f=rep(125,10))
ggplot(b) +
  geom_tile(aes(y=y, x=x, fill=f))

I understand that these examples are contrived - they have been simplified to try to isolate the issue.

Thanks in advance for any guidance

Simon

b <- data.frame(x=rep(100L,10), y=as.factor(1L:10L), f=rep(125,10))
